title: Test applications need their own dependency registration
problem: An integration handler cannot resolve a service even though the production app works.
cause: The test application assembles a separate dependency injection container.
solution: Register the service in the test application module as well as the production module.
verification: Synthetic example. Verify against the target project before relying on it.
applies_to: Projects with separately assembled test and production containers
failed_attempts: Clearing caches does not register a missing dependency.
